short_description: GTA 6 broke streaming launch records within minutes: over 7 million people watched at the same time across Twitch, Kick and YouTube, and Twitch alone peaked above 3 million (Streams Charts, Insider Gaming; preliminary numbers). #ViceReplayBreaking

short.headline: 7 MILLION WATCHING
short.text: Over seven million people were watching GTA 6 streams at the same time last night.
short.text_es: Más de siete millones de personas estaban viendo streams de GTA 6 al mismo tiempo anoche.

short.headline: RECORD LAUNCH
short.text: According to Streams Charts, it broke streaming launch records within minutes, across Twitch, Kick and YouTube.
short.text_es: Según Streams Charts, rompió récords de lanzamiento en streaming en minutos, entre Twitch, Kick y YouTube.

short.headline: TWITCH: 3 MILLION+
short.text: Twitch alone peaked above three million viewers, right next to its all time gaming record.
short.text_es: Solo Twitch pasó los tres millones de espectadores, justo al lado de su récord histórico de juegos.
